title: Fase 02 A.7 — Persistencia Sanity vía Cloud Function (publicar reseñas + IA + imágenes)
description: RE-PLANEADO (antes Firestore+Storage). Persistencia sobre Sanity con escritura segura server-side. Una Firebase Cloud Function actúa de proxy que guarda los secretos SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN (scope Administrator — un token Viewer da 403) y ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, y expone: (a) generar borrador del cuerpo de la reseña con blog-component generatePostBody (Claude) → PortableText; (b) subir imágenes a Sanity image assets vía el write-adapter (useImageUpload del lib); (c) publicar/actualizar documentos resena (+ hueca nueva si aplica) en Sanity gvc4yjqj. El wizard de /admin (TASK-010) COMBINA IA + edición: pide borrador a la IA, el crítico lo refina, sube fotos y publica. Solo críticos autenticados (claim de Firebase Auth, A.5/A.6) pueden invocar la función. La lectura pública sigue siendo el snapshot build-time (TASK-018). Los secretos se configuran en Firebase Functions (config/secret manager) — nunca en el bundle del browser ni en el repo. Cierra el milestone de andamio.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud Function desplegada con SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN (Administrator) y ANTHROPIC_API_KEY server-side; ningún secreto llega al browser ni al repo
Solo usuarios autenticados con rol crítico/admin (Firebase Auth claim) pueden invocar la función (rechazo a anónimos)
El wizard puede pedir un borrador con IA (generatePostBody) y el crítico editarlo antes de publicar
El wizard sube fotos a Sanity image assets (alt/caption/credit/size) reemplazando blob URLs
Publicar escribe un documento resena (y hueca nueva si se creó) en Sanity gvc4yjqj con autoGenerateArrayKeys; borra el draft local con toast + link
El contenido publicado aparece en el siguiente build (snapshot de TASK-018) para lectores anónimos

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DONE — implemented (TDD), independently reviewed (PASS, no HIGH), deployed, and live-verified.

Commits on main:
- c6eb473 feat: AI reseña draft + Sanity publish callables wired into /admin
- 1226e49 fix: guard against publishing imageless reseña + document new env params
- 6f5f5a1 fix: drop ANTHROPIC_MODEL from secrets:[] and correct 401/403 gotcha note

What shipped:
- Two Functions v2 callables (us-central1, Node 22), críticos/admins only: generateResenaDraft (Claude forced-tool-call → {titulo,extracto,bodyMarkdown}) and publishResena (uploads photos to Sanity image assets, writes resena + optional new hueca to gvc4yjqj/production with autoGenerateArrayKeys). Pure markdownToPortableText + slugify in functions/lib/portableText.js (unit-tested).
- Wizard (ResenaWizard.vue): "Generar con IA" button + real onPublicar (publishes, deletes local draft, success banner/link), optional crítico selector, imageless-publish guard.
- functions runtime upgraded Node 20 → 22.

Secrets: SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY now in Google Secret Manager (defineSecret, bound via secrets:[]); ANTHROPIC_MODEL + ADMIN_EMAIL stay as defineString in functions/.env. Those two secret keys were commented out of functions/.env (CLI refuses to deploy a secret-named key that also lives in .env). No secret in repo/bundle.

Verification (acceptance criteria):
1. Deployed w/ secrets server-side, none in browser/repo — OK.
2. Anonymous rejected — curl POST to both deployed callables returns HTTP 401 {"status":"UNAUTHENTICATED"} (reachable + guard ran; allUsers invoker correctly set on clean create).
3. AI draft — generateResenaDraft's exact prompt/tool/model (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) produced valid titulo/extracto/markdown against the real Anthropic API.
4/5/6. Wrote a real labeled test reseña (+ new hueca, uploaded 1x1 image asset) to production via the real portableText.js converter + publishResena's exact doc shape; the real snapshot (scripts/snapshot-sanity.mjs) picked it up (huecas 2→3, resenas 1→2) with hueca/critico refs resolved to slugs, rating, imagen asset, link markDef, and veredicto blockquote all present. Test docs + asset then deleted; snapshot back to 2/1.

Test = 43 vitest passing; typecheck clean. The deployed HTTPS callable's auth gate was verified via curl (401); a full browser round-trip with a real crítico ID token was not done headlessly (needs interactive Google sign-in) — the publish/persistence logic was instead exercised end-to-end against the same real Sanity/Anthropic services.

Follow-up (not blocking, suggest TASK-019 or a new ticket): veredicto is currently appended to the body as a blockquote rather than written to resena.veredicto {aFavor,enContra,ticket} — the wizard collects free text. Decide whether to capture structured veredicto fields.
